labelled: 2026-11-10, definitions: analysis plan + A3/A5; two labellers, reviewed by the agent
label_justification: Loop evidence holds from call 9, which printed the longest identical-line runs and the tails of generations cut at 32768 tokens; calls 12 and 19-20 extended this with repeated-suffix families and loop-onset positions. The locus is tied to that evidence from call 24, which ranked MLP neurons by activation at loop positions versus non-loop reasoning positions in the loop traces, with per-trace consistency; call 25 checked neuron L14 n891 (loop mean 0.189 vs reasoning mean 0.029). Later work repeated this on real loop traces: L22/L23 gate neurons at loop vs pre-loop vs success positions (calls 232-236) and stop-token rank at loop line starts. No submitted edit repaired the failure. The L0 head-8 decay fix (call 63) scored 0.094 on the paired diagnostic. The L22 stop edit (call 30) scored 0.109 against 0.121 for the original, a null result. The L22/L23 conditional stop edit (call 53) scored 0.0. The dense gate edit (call 265) scored 0.0, and the sparse gate edit (call 279) scored 0.0, with 231 of 256 generations finishing without an answer. The alpha=50 edit (call 297 onward) was reverted, and the final submission scored 0.072, below the 0.29 needed for success.

label_second.label: localised, edit failed
label_second.justification: Call 9 computed identical-line repetition statistics and printed a looping generation with 32,768 tokens, satisfying (i). Call 22 compared MLP neuron activations at repeated-span loop positions against reasoning positions, satisfying (ii); calls 24–26 further identified specific neurons. Tested edits failed to repair the failure: calls 18, 53, 265 and 279 reported very low or zero accuracy, and the later attenuation was tested in calls 319, 321 and 326 before being withdrawn in call 328. The submission scored 0.072, below 0.29. Call 248 explicitly described the edit store as broken.

label_review: Rules-v1 reference run (not the strict2 matrix). Both labellers: localised, edit failed; (i) call 9, (ii) call 24/22. Self-report: 0 contradicted. Tool-use failure rests on Codex's call 248 ('diagnose the broken edit store'): after save_edit reported success the editor saw an empty edited() mirror; whether the mirror really failed in that rules-v1 run (Mac node, 11-08) is not verified.
